title: Bucket of Ghastling
body:
A Bukkit Plugin to Bucket your Ghastling!
-----------------------------------------
Happy Ghast is a helpful mob for building and travelling, but carrying them around is really a pain; This Plugin is here to solve just that

This is a simple Bukkit Plugin that adds the Bucket of Ghastling to game

For usage, simply hold an empty bucket in hand and press right click towards a ghastling (Baby Happy Ghast)

The exact time (in ticks) that it takes for the Ghastling stored to grow is visualized via attributes![Bucket of Ghastling (With NBT {Age})](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ead0482078c74e358881cf8c997edd49fc7343f.png)
